summary: Keel Infrastructure Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing the issuance of $458 million aggregate principal of 1.250% Convertible Senior Notes due 2032, including a $58 million full exercise of the initial purchasers' option, under an indenture with Computershare Trust Company, N.A. as trustee and Bitfarms Ltd. as guarantor. The notes are senior unsecured obligations ranking equally with existing convertible notes. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC action, or forced management change is present. This is a routine capital markets financing transaction. What to watch: ordinary convertible arbitrage and dilution risk.
